calls.reason: Anthropic’s $30 billion funding round confirms outside financing, but the packet does not show what share of global compute revenue depends on it. The percentage estimate is also explicitly hedged.

Amazon’s AI run rate and Alphabet’s cloud growth do not establish comparable AI returns across the three companies. Neither disclosure shows that poor performance explains reluctance to discuss revenue.
Epoch explicitly excludes actual utilization from its measurements. The packet therefore does not show whether the buildout gets fully used or whether the stated customer conditions hold.

Anthropic’s filing establishes payment risk, while Microsoft reports substantial business outside frontier labs. Neither establishes how losing lab payments would affect all three companies’ growth prospects.
JLL projects nearly 100 GW of additions and trillions in investment through 2030. That supports the buildout’s scale, but does not quantify demand needed for capacity already under construction.

NVIDIA’s filing documents large financing guarantees, while its earnings call describes capacity secured without its support. These show exposure but do not establish that its entire future requires expanding financing.
